summary: The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme, run by the Research Grants Council, funds about 400 outstanding PhD students a year at Hong Kong's universities. It is open to applicants of any nationality and pays a generous stipend plus a conference and research travel allowance.
meta_description: Hong Kong's PhD Fellowship pays HK$344,400 a year plus travel funds for a PhD at a Hong Kong university, any nationality. Eligibility and the deadline.
covers: An annual stipend of HK$344,400 (2026/27 rate).
A conference and research travel allowance of HK$14,400 a year.
Normally up to three years of funding.
Many universities add a tuition waiver or extra support for fellows; check your university.
eligibility: Applicants of any country of origin.
Outstanding academic records, research ability, communication skills and leadership.
Applying for full-time PhD study at a participating Hong Kong university.
how_to_apply: Submit the initial online application to the Research Grants Council between 1 September and 1 December 2026, 12:00 noon Hong Kong time, to get your reference number.
Apply for PhD admission to your chosen university, quoting the reference number, by that university's deadline.
Universities nominate candidates and the council makes the final selection.
watch_out: Late initial applications are not considered, and the cutoff is noon, not midnight.
Some universities set their own deadline on or before 1 December; check each one.
Contact potential supervisors early, since a strong research fit helps a nomination.
